info.title: joinedcontext Portal API
info.description: Administrative and platform management REST API for joinedcontext Portal

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` — clears the session and tells the SPA where to send the browser.
post.description:
It answers with JSON rather than a 302 on purpose: the SPA calls this with `fetch`, and a
cross-origin redirect to Keycloak is unreadable to it. The browser navigation is the caller's.

get.summary: The logo or the favicon, read from beside the branding file (UI-30).
get.description:
The file name comes from the branding block, which already refused anything but a
same-origin file name, and it is joined to the branding file's own directory: the two
assets a ConfigMap carries are the only files this route can ever reach. Served as an
image, which is the only way the UI uses it, so an SVG cannot run script.

ApproveBody.description: Request body for approving or rejecting a change proposal.

Artifacts.description:
What one Model Tools run rendered. Every artifact is optional: a version that does not
render one omits it, and a source that does not compile yet answers with `errors` filled in
and the artifacts absent. A half-written model is the normal state of an editor.

docs.description:
The documentation page, one Markdown file for the whole model: the same page
`jcctl model generate` commits beside the source, so the editor previews what a
reviewer will approve rather than a second rendering of it (DM-02, DM-32, DM-43).

errors.description: Compilation messages. Non-empty with no artifacts means the source does not compile.

generatorVersion.description:
The generator version that produced these artifacts, so a preview and a committed
artifact set can be compared (DM-19).

linkml.description:
The LinkML source itself, which an import produces and the editor then edits; its
annotations carry `spec.source.repository`, `path` and `commit` (DM-07, DM-08).

Branding.description: Everything the Portal shows that names or themes an installation.

city.description: The city or region this installation serves.

oneOf.description: The colour tokens the UI writes as CSS custom properties.

contactEmail.description: The DCAT-AP contact point and the footer's address.

favicon.description: Favicon file, served from the platform's own origin.

oneOf.description: The font stacks the UI writes as CSS custom properties.

instanceName.description: Full name: page titles and the login page.

oneOf.description: The locales the language switcher offers.

logo.description: Logo file, served from the platform's own origin.

orgDomain.description: The organization's domain: URN segment, realm display name, `did:web`.

organisation.description: The legal publisher, which is also the DCAT-AP `dcterms:publisher`.

primaryForeground.description:
Readable text on top of the primary colour. Always computed from that colour, never
taken from the file: the block names a primary colour but no foreground, and white on
a light primary is unreadable (WCAG 1.4.3). A value in the file is overwritten.

shortName.description:
Short name: sidebars, tabs, e-mail subjects. A block that omits it gets the full name,
so the field default is empty rather than the struct's.

Catalogue.description: The catalogue index Model Tools caches and refreshes daily (DM-12).

refreshedAt.description: When the cache was last filled from the catalogue.

stale.description:
The last refresh did not reach the catalogue, so this index is the older cached one.
An index a browser cannot refresh is still an index it can work from (DM-12).

CatalogueModel.description: One model of the Smart Data Models catalogue index, as the wizard lists and searches it.

attributes.description: Attribute names, so the wizard can search by attribute without fetching the model.

CatalogueSubject.description: One subject of the catalogue: `dataModel.Environment` and the models under it.

Change.description: The `Change` resource describing a proposed configuration update.

ChangeAuthor.description: Human author attributed on the change proposal.

name.description:
Identifier formatted as `chg-` plus eight lowercase hex characters derived
from the merge request.

ChangeProposal.description: A change proposal representing an open Git merge request.

ChangeStatus.description: Approval and reconciliation status of a change.

ChangeSummary.description: Human-readable proposal summary parameters derived from the plan diff.

CkanStatus.description: The CKAN picture of one project.

instances.description: Every catalogue this project can publish to.

publications.description: One entry per endpoint that declares `spec.publish.ckan`.

Colours.description:
The five colours a page is built from. Each is validated as a hex triplet or sextet before
it is served, because the UI writes it into a CSS custom property and a value that is not a
colour is a way into the page (OPS-46).

secondary.description: Secondary accent used for links and focus.

refresh.description: How the mirror is kept current.

representation.description: The tabular representation the rows are read through.

DryRunResult.description: Reviewer-facing validation and diff result returned on `?dryRun=All` (MF-13, R17).

Edge.description: One directed relation between two nodes.

manifest.description: The manifest this edge was read from, as `kind/name`, so a reader can open it.

edges.description: Directed edges, each naming the manifest it was read from.

nodes.description: Every object the federation touches, keyed by `kind/name`.

FieldChange.description:
A single leaf field modification in a plan diff.

Paths are dotted strings rooted at `metadata` or `spec` (e.g. `spec.audience`,
`spec.representations[1]`, `metadata.labels.joinedcontext.com/domain`).
Keys containing dots (such as reverse-DNS label names) are deliberately not escaped.

FlowRequest.description: Running a blueprint: the parameters the form collected (API/01 §13).

parameters.description: The values the user filled in, validated against `spec.parameterSchema` (CC-24).

version.description:
The version the form was generated from. A mismatch is a conflict rather than an
expansion against a schema the user never saw (CC-26).

Fonts.description:
Heading and body font stacks. Self-hosted or system families only: nothing on a page
fetches from a third-party origin at runtime.

source.description: LinkML YAML, exactly as the editor holds it.

Identity.description: Who is signed in. Returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/me` and used by every protected route.

roles.description:
Keycloak realm roles from the ID token's `realm_access.roles` (CC-42). Empty when the
token asserts none. Display and enablement only — the resource API and the forge enforce
the same boundaries independently.

subject.description: Keycloak `sub`: stable, opaque, the only durable user key.

ImportSdmRequest.description: A model to import from the Smart Data Models catalogue.

model.description:
Catalogue identifier, `dataModel.Environment/AirQualityObserved`. Never a URL: the
allowlist that limits fetching to the Smart Data Models organisation lives in Model
Tools (DM-10), and the Portal refuses anything a caller could steer.

InstanceSummary.description: One `CkanInstance`, without anything secret about it.

apiTokenRef.description: The name of the secret holding the API token. Never its value (EP-67).

organizationDefault.description: The organization a dataset lands in when the endpoint names none.

KeyInfo.description:
One key as everyone else ever sees it: what an operator decides on, and nothing that opens
a door.

Languages.description: The locale the UI starts in and the ones it offers.

default.description: The locale a first-time visitor gets.

offered.description: Every locale the switcher lists; always contains the default.

LogoutTarget.description: The URL the browser must visit to finish an RP-initiated logout at Keycloak.

endSessionUrl.description:
Absolute URL: Keycloak's `end_session_endpoint`, or the portal itself when no realm is
configured.

MintedKey.description: A minted key. The only place a raw token ever appears (PF-36).

id.description: `kind/name`, stable across runs so a selection survives a refresh.

kind.description: Manifest kind, or `ExternalSource` for a source outside this platform.

name.description: Manifest name. For an external source, the name of the registration that reaches it.

oneOf.description: For a `ContextSourceRegistration`, what the card may say about it. Never a credential.

title.description:
The object's title as the manifest carries it, one entry per language. Absent when the
manifest has none: the UI falls back to the name rather than the Portal inventing one.

ObjectMeta.title: ObjectMeta
ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

received.description:
Cumulative since the runner started, exactly as it reports them: a rate is the view's
job, history is Prometheus' job (OPS-16). An absent field is not zero, it is a counter
this runner does not export.

scrapedAt.description: When the Portal read the runner, RFC 3339. The counters are as old as this instant.

PlanDiff.description: Summary and field-level changes between two resource revisions.

dashboardLayouts.description: Free JSON per dashboard name, the browser's own saved state.

defaultProject.description: The project the shell opens on.

errors.description:
Every violation of one request, when there is more than one thing to say. A form marks
all its bad fields from this in one pass instead of one round trip per mistake (CC-24).

PublicationStatus.description: What one endpoint publishes, and where.

datasetUrl.description: Where the dataset is in the catalogue, once it is published.

oneOf.description: The row mirror, when the endpoint asks for one (EP-65).

endpoint.description: The endpoint that declares the publication.

instanceMissing.description: `true` when that instance is missing from the project, which is why nothing publishes.

organization.description: The CKAN organization the dataset lands in.

phase.description: The endpoint's lifecycle phase, as the mirror reports it.

resources.description: One resource per enabled representation, plus the schema index (EP-64).

RegistrationCard.description: What a registration's card shows (UI-27, PF-48).

external.description: Whether the source is on this platform or outside it.

types.description: The entity types the source is claimed to hold.

oneOf.description: Never read from Git, always computed by the Portal API (MF-04).

ResourceLink.description: One CKAN resource of a dataset.

name.description: What the resource is called in CKAN.

url.description: The URL a citizen clicks, always under the endpoint (EP-66).

Status.description:
The status the Portal API reports (MF-04). It is `jc_core::Status` plus `sourceUrl` and a phase
that is always known; it stays a Portal type until jc-core carries `sourceUrl` too (docs API/01
section 6 is the contract), then it becomes a re-export like its neighbours.

sourceUrl.description:
Forge page of the file this manifest was read from, so a view can link "Source"
without knowing where a kind lives in the repository. Computed, never read from Git.

SyncStatus.description:
Status of the background Git mirror synchronization.

Served to the browser, so it deliberately never carries a token,
repository URL, or branch name.

leader.description:
Whether this replica is the one that reconciles (CC-03). A Portal without a database
has no election to run and reconciles on its own, so it reports itself as the leader.
